recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current core follow-up is needed; future live VerificationResult changes should be made in the HL7 Admin Incubator source unless the resource is reintroduced to core.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Patient Administration request to update VerificationResult.primarySource.organization so a primary source can be an Organization or Practitioner, and to rename the element to who because it is no longer organization-specific.
initial_application: Git commit ffe009e9cf00c81dc11cf81d1045b641b0d9a7bb explicitly cited GF#18136 and changed the then-active source/verificationresult/verificationresult-spreadsheet.xml from VerificationResult.primarySource.organization Reference(Organization) to VerificationResult.primarySource.who Reference(Organization|Practitioner).
additional_context: PA minutes confirm the 6-0-0 acceptance and a later PA call approved adding PractitionerRole reference targets for VerificationResult.primarySource.who. Current core source/fhir.ini has no active VerificationResult resource entry, source/verificationresult was removed by commit 71567db3ee039ac6977be5f96a7e013896569a36, and current history/ballot pages point to the HL7 Admin Incubator copy. The current Admin Incubator StructureDefinition has primarySource.who as Reference(Organization|Practitioner|PractitionerRole).
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is appropriate in current core because the resource is out of build scope and the surviving/external representations already carry the requested rename and reference target semantics.
